title: Elementary Profile Base Width for Gravity Dam

params.name: Total water height acting upstream
Specific gravity of dam concrete / masonry
Uplift pressure reduction factor
Coefficient of friction between dam base & rock

notes: Determines theoretical minimum base width for no tension at heel and adequate factor of safety against sliding.

title: Hydrodynamic Earthquake Force (Zanger's Formula)

params.name: Maximum value of pressure coefficient
Horizontal earthquake seismic acceleration coefficient
Unit weight of water
Total depth of reservoir water

notes: Computes hydrodynamic pressure distribution and overturning moment on vertical/inclined upstream face during seismic events.

title: Seepage Discharge through Homogeneous Earth Dam
latex_main: q = k \cdot s = k \cdot \left(\sqrt{d^2 + H^2} - d\right)
latex_sub: s = \sqrt{d^2 + H^2} - d \quad \text{(Focal Distance for Casagrande Base Parabola)}

params.name: Coefficient of permeability of embankment soil
Head of water retained on upstream side
Horizontal distance from upstream toe entry to focus
Focal distance parameter of basic phreatic parabola

notes: Governing equation in Casagrande's analytical method for seepage discharge per unit length with horizontal toe filter.

title: Lacey's Regime Waterway for Barrages & Weirs

params.name: Design peak flood discharge
Regime wetted perimeter (clear waterway)
Lacey silt factor of river bed material
Normal scour depth below high flood level

notes: Fundamental formula used to fix waterway and crest levels for diversion barrages and undersluices.

title: Discharge Formula for Sarda Type Canal Fall

params.name: Canal full supply discharge
Length of crest of the canal fall
Total head over the crest including velocity of approach
Coefficient of discharge for broad crested weir

notes: Determines crest length, crest height, and energy dissipation cistern depth for vertical drop Sarda falls.

title: Ogee Spillway Downstream Profile (USBR)
latex_sub: Q = C \cdot L_e \cdot H_e^{3/2} \quad \text{(Ogee Spillway Discharge)}

params.name: Coordinates of downstream profile with crest as origin
Design head excluding velocity of approach
Discharge coefficient for standard ogee crest
Effective length of spillway crest taking pier contraction into account

notes: US Army Corps / WES standard equation defining the lower nappe trajectory to prevent cavitation and sub-atmospheric pressures.
